title: Lesson 07: Portrait Mode
sources: Samsung Camera Portrait mode: zoom options 1x/2x/3x/5x and a 'Ready' indicator when the effect can be applied (creator's own screenshot)
Background blur increases with subject-to-background distance (standard optics)

lines.text: Swipe to Portrait, and wait for the word Ready.
Pick three x for natural, flattering faces,
and step back, so your subject fills the frame.
Keep some distance between them and the background.
The farther it is, the creamier the blur.
It works on pets and objects too, not just people.
